title: Turn off tailored experiences with diagnostic data
description: Sets the documented policy value DisableTailoredExperiencesWithDiagnosticData under HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\CloudContent to 1. Windows stops using diagnostic data to build personalized tips, tricks and recommendations. The value is written to the current user hive; the previous value and its type are captured in a snapshot before the change and restored by per-feature undo.
